sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:149858
Court No. - 86
Case :- Transfer Application (Criminal) No. - 420 of 2024

Applicant :- Yashpal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Anuj Bajpai,G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The present transfer application has been moved by the applicant / husband under Section 407 Cr.P.C. seeking transfer of Case No.270 of 2018 in case crime no. 1698 of 2017 under Sections 498A,
323, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Sadar Bazar, Shahjahanpur pending before the Additional Judicial Magistrate, Ist, Shahjahanpur to the Competent Court at Pilibhit.

3. Relevant facts in this matter, as mentioned in the application by the applicant, are that he is the husband of opposite party no.2 and their marriage took place on 28.11.2016 according to Hindu rites and customs.
Thereafter some dispute arose between them.
It is further submitted that according to FIR in brief, the opposite party no.2 leveled the general allegation of cruelty and harassment for further demand of dowry.
It is further submitted that only to harass the husband/ applicant aforesaid case was filed against him at district Shahjahanpur.

It is further submitted that the several cases filed by the opposite party no.2 against the applicant and his family members are pending at Yashpal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126081578/
1 district Pilibhit.

entities.text: Yashpal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that at district Shahjahanpur there are great apprehension to the applicant for his life and the distance from Pilibhit to Shahjahanpur is also far away about 90 Kms.

On these grounds a prayer has been made to transfer the said case from Shahjahanpur to Pilibhit.
4.
Learned

5. The allegations made in the transfer petition have been vehemently denied by the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2.
6. I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the entire record carefully.
7.
No universal or hard and fast rules can be applied for deciding a transfer application which is always to be decided on the basis of facts of each case.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in Vijay Pal and others Vs. State of Haryana and another, 1999 (9) SCC 67 has held that in absence of any justified reason, it is not proper and legal to exercise power under Section 407 Cr.P.C.
8.

entities.text: Vijay Pal and others Vs. State of Haryana and another, 1999 (9) SCC 67
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A party, either complainant or the accused should not ordinarily be allowed to have the Forum of his/her own choice.
A transfer applicant cannot be allowed to make unfounded charges.
A transfer should not be granted on a fancied notion of a litigant.
Where the ground for transfer is not substantiated and as such does not exist, the application for transfer should not be allowed.
It should not be allowed to help a litigant to choose a Bench of his own choice.

9. There is matrimonial dispute between the parties and convenience of wife to pursue the proceedings is a relevant factor if pleaded bona fide for justifying transfer of a matter to the place where it is convenient to the wife.
The grounds taken by the applicant in the present transfer application do not justify the transfer of case as prayed by the applicant.
10. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, I do not find any good ground to interfere in the matter.
11. The transfer application is, accordingly, rejected.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Fhd  Yashpal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/126081578/
